statement_made: I’m ready to prove I belong in the league. Green Bay is getting a worker. Let’s get to the frozen tundra.
event_description: First public reaction after being selected by the Green Bay Packers in the second round of the 2026 NFL Draft.

statement_made: Trey has a high motor and great lateral quickness. We think he adds immediate value to our pass rush rotation.
event_description: Packers GM evaluating the selection of edge rusher Trey Moore.

statement_made: The backfield in Philly is going to be scary. Grateful for the opportunity to carry the rock for the Eagles.
event_description: Addressing fans after being selected by the Philadelphia Eagles in the second round.

statement_made: Welcome to the squad, Quinshon. Let's make some noise together.
event_description: Eagles veteran running back Saquon Barkley welcoming rookie Quinshon Judkins via social media.

statement_made: Ready to bring some Georgia grit to the 49ers. Protecting Purdy is the only mission.
event_description: Reacting to being drafted by the San Francisco 49ers in the early third round.

statement_made: Tate is a physical, nasty guard. He’s exactly the kind of interior presence we need for our zone scheme.
event_description: 49ers GM discussing the draft selection of offensive lineman Tate Ratledge.

statement_made: Denver is a great fit for my style of play. Ready to work with Bo and make some plays in the altitude.
event_description: First public reaction after being selected by the Denver Broncos.

statement_made: Terrance provides a big target and reliable hands. He’s a smart player who understands spacing in our offense.
event_description: Broncos HC explaining why Terrance Ferguson was a target for their tight end room.

statement_made: L.A. lifestyle, but the Michigan work ethic. Can't wait to play for Coach Harbaugh again.
event_description: Reflecting on being drafted by the Los Angeles Chargers and reuniting with Jim Harbaugh.

statement_made: Colston is an absolute winner. He’s a versatile tight end who can block like a tackle and catch like a receiver.
event_description: Chargers HC discussing the selection of his former Michigan tight end Colston Loveland.

statement_made: Dallas, you got a playmaker. I’m ready to follow in the footsteps of the greats who wore the star.
event_description: Addressing Cowboys fans after being selected in the first round.

statement_made: Ollie has that 'it' factor. He’s a physical runner who can also catch out of the backfield—a true three-down back.
event_description: Cowboys owner Jerry Jones praising rookie running back Ollie Gordon II.

statement_made: Cincinnati is a great city with a great tradition. Ready to catch some TDs from Joe Brrr.
event_description: First social media post after being drafted by the Cincinnati Bengals in the third round.

statement_made: Tory has some serious speed and route-running ability. Looking forward to getting him integrated into the offense.
event_description: Bengals QB Joe Burrow commenting on the addition of rookie wide receiver Tory Horton.

statement_made: The Island is moving to Jacksonville. Ready to lock down the AFC South.
event_description: Addressing the media after being selected No. 5 overall by the Jacksonville Jaguars.

statement_made: Will is a premier talent. His size, length, and technical ability make him a day-one starter in this league.
event_description: Jaguars GM on why Will Johnson was the clear choice at No. 5 overall.

statement_made: I’m coming for everything. Tampa Bay is getting a hunter. Let’s work.
event_description: Draft night reaction after being selected by the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in the second round.

statement_made: Princely is an explosive pass rusher with a huge ceiling. We love his frame and his first-step quickness.
event_description: Buccaneers GM discussing the potential of edge rusher Princely Umanmielen.

statement_made: I’ve been dreaming of this moment my whole life. Ready to block for Caleb and build a winner in Chicago.
event_description: Reflecting on being a first-round pick for the Chicago Bears during a post-draft interview.

statement_made: Kelvin is a cornerstone tackle. He’s got the size, the strength, and the football IQ to protect our franchise for a long time.
event_description: Bears GM justifying the selection of Kelvin Banks Jr. in the top 10.
